intent: Cap-only image layers aligned like the user's green keycap reference. Original keyswitch.avif preserved.
master: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied isolated keycap image, which is the exact replacement-layer geometry for an existing clickable website key. Preserve its exact camera, trapezoidal silhouette, perspective, bevels, top-face position, proportions, and tight framing. Change red translucent resin to premium near-black satin resin, retaining the existing sculpted folds and lighting. Replace ONLY the embossed squiggle on the top face with a clean browser-window outline with code angle brackets inside, physically engraved and filled flush with muted champagne-gold metal. Match that top face's perspective; elegant readable icon, no circular patch. CAP ONLY. Absolutely no switch, housing, base, stem, keyboard, floor, or shadow beneath the object. Those are separate existing image layers and MUST NOT be generated. Transparent alpha background to the exact cap outline. Object fills frame edge to edge like reference; maintain landscape 512:414 aspect ratio. No words, watermark, glow, detached icon, or new shapes outside the cap.
positionCorrection: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: isolated black keycap. Image 2 is a REFERENCE for correct positioning/orientation of the lettering on its top face. Fix ONLY the gold browser/code icon in image 1. Like the T/E/N/G lettering on the green reference, the icon must lie flat, centered optically on the top face, aligned to the keycap's own top-face axes, visibly foreshortened and skewed with that plane. The current icon looks like it faces the viewer independently: correct that. In particular its left/right edges must run diagonally down-right parallel to the side edges of the top face, not vertically down. Its horizontal browser edges run up-right parallel to the rear/front edges of that top face. Make the icon somewhat smaller with generous equal optical margins; keep it entirely within the flat top face, as flush engraved champagne-gold inlay. Preserve the exact cap silhouette, camera, black satin material, sculpted folds, perspective, lighting and edge-to-edge landscape framing. DO NOT copy the green color or letters. CAP ONLY: no switch, housing, stem, base or assembly. Transparent background, exact original silhouette, no glow, floor, cast shadow, badge or watermark.

Same generous margins, same optical center, same foreshortening, same champagne-gold engraved flush inlay. Do NOT make a front-facing icon. Keep EVERY other pixel's appearance unchanged: black satin resin cap, geometry, silhouette, camera, sculpted folds, highlights, tight edge-to-edge landscape framing and transparent alpha background. CAP ONLY; absolutely no switch, housing, stem, base or assembled keyboard. No floor, background, glow, shadow beneath cap, letters or watermark.
